units.failure: Act agent reported ok:false: Implemented FileStore.FrozenIDs in backend/internal/contribution/frozen.go per Step 1: safepath.Segment validation for worldID and roundID, reads worlds/<world>/rounds/<lower round>/snapshot.yaml, returns nil,false,nil on fs.ErrNotExist, otherwise parses the contributions[].id list and returns ids,true,nil. `gofmt -l`, `go build ./...` and `go vet ./internal/contribution` all pass in backend/. Adapted Step 1: I omitted `var _ ExportSource = (*FileStore)(nil)` because ExportSource is not defined anywhere in the repo or git history (REQ-128 only names it; it presumably comes from UNIT-254, which is not in this worktree). Adding the assertion needs that interface first; if I had defined it here it would collide with UNIT-254. Unit is blocked only on the ExportSource assertion; FrozenIDs itself is done. units.title: Verify: Exporter format, empty round and frozen-only unit tests

tests.name: TestExport_Format
tests.title: Exporter emits the versioned JSON format with explicit fields for two frozen contributions
tests.scenario: Given a source with two frozen contributions with fixed CreatedAt, when Export runs and the result is json.Marshalled, then the JSON equals the expected literal with version 1, world, round, and each entry's id, author, content, created_at

tests.name: TestExport_EmptyRound
tests.title: Exporter of a frozen round with no frozen contributions emits an empty contributions array
tests.scenario: Given a frozen round with no frozen ids, when Export runs and the result is marshalled, then the JSON contains "contributions":[]

tests.name: TestExport_OnlyFrozen
tests.title: Exporter lists only snapshot-frozen contributions, in created_at order
tests.scenario: Given 3 listed contributions and 2 frozen ids, when Export runs, then exactly the 2 frozen contributions are returned in created_at order

tests.name: TestExport_NotFrozen
tests.title: Exporter refuses to export a round that has no snapshot
tests.scenario: Given frozen=false, when Export runs, then errors.Is(err, ErrNotFrozen) holds

tests.name: TestFrozenIDs
tests.title: FrozenIDs returns snapshot contribution IDs in order for a frozen round
tests.scenario: Given round-0000001 has a snapshot.yaml listing CON-a and CON-b, When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns [CON-a CON-b] and frozen=true with no error

tests.name: TestFrozenIDs
tests.title: FrozenIDs reports not frozen with nil IDs when a round has no snapshot
tests.scenario: Given round-0000002 has no snapshot.yaml, When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns nil, false and no error

tests.name: TestFrozenIDs
tests.title: FrozenIDs rejects an unsafe world ID with an error
tests.scenario: Given worldID is "../x", When FrozenIDs is called, Then it returns a non-nil error

units.title: REQ · Frozen export has a documented stable JSON format with only frozen contributions
